name: Hello World Computer
description: The one-of-one onchain artwork of the Hello World Computer: a WebGL particle field driven by its yes/no tallies.
about:
## The computer's one-of-one artwork

This is the single, unique artwork tied to the Hello World Computer. There is exactly one — no editions, no copies. The piece is generated entirely onchain: calling `artpiece()` returns a complete HTML and WebGL2 document that renders a living particle field. The artwork reads the computer's current yes and no answer tallies and uses them to size its two particle states, so the image evolves as the computer learns.

## Owning and trading it

Ownership uses a minimal, self-contained marketplace in the spirit of CryptoPunks rather than a standard ERC-721. The current owner can list it for sale at a fixed ETH price — open to anyone, or reserved for one specific address — and can cancel a listing or hand the piece directly to someone with `transferOwnership`. A buyer takes it by calling `buyNow()` with exactly the asking price. The full sale price goes to the seller, who collects it with `withdraw()`.

## Not a standard NFT

Because ownership is tracked by this contract's own logic, the artwork may not appear or move like a normal token in wallets and marketplaces that expect ERC-721. It exposes `name()` ("Hello World Computer") and `symbol()` ("HWC") for display, and `owner()` for the current holder.
risks: This is a single one-of-one artwork with a custom ownership model — it is not a standard ERC-721 and may not appear or transfer like one in wallets and marketplaces.
Buying requires sending exactly the asking price; any other amount reverts.
A listing can be reserved for one specific buyer — anyone else calling buyNow reverts.
Sale proceeds are pull-based: the seller must call withdraw() to collect them.
Transferring ownership moves the artwork with no payment and clears any active listing.
Listing, cancelling, and transferring are restricted to the current owner.

buyNow.title: Buy Now
buyNow.description: Buy the artwork at its current asking price by sending exactly the listed ETH, which is credited to the seller.
buyNow.warning: Send exactly the asking price (see Current Offer). If the listing is reserved for a specific address, only that address can buy.

listForSale.title: List for Sale
listForSale.description: List the artwork for sale at a fixed ETH price, open to anyone or reserved for one buyer; owner only.

fields.label: Reserved buyer
fields.description: Restrict the sale to this address, or use the zero address to sell to anyone.

listForSale.warning: Owner only. The price must be greater than zero. Listing replaces any existing offer.

toAddress.label: Reserved buyer
toAddress.description: Restrict the sale to this address, or use the zero address to sell to anyone.

cancelFromSale.title: Cancel Listing
cancelFromSale.description: Take the artwork off the market, removing any active offer. Only the current owner can cancel.

currentOffer.title: Current Offer
currentOffer.description: The artwork's current sale offer: whether it is for sale, the asking price, and any reserved buyer.

owner.title: Owner
owner.description: The current owner of the artwork.

transferOwnership.title: Transfer Ownership
transferOwnership.description: Hand the artwork to another address off-market with no payment, clearing any active listing; owner only.
transferOwnership.warning: Owner only. This is a gift — no ETH changes hands — and it cancels any active listing.

artpiece.title: Artwork
artpiece.description: The full HTML and WebGL2 artwork document, generated onchain and embedding the computer's current yes/no tallies.

computer.title: Computer
